 This application coming on for orders this day, th e cou  following:

ORDER This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail to the applicant,
relating to FIR/Crime No.26/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at P.S. Maheshwar, District Khargone (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376(2)(n), 344 of IPC, 5L/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and sec. 3(1)(w)(i) and 3(2)(V-A) and 3(2)(V) of SC & ST (PA) Act.
2. It is alleged that applicant had abducted a minor girl and committed rape with her.
3. Counsel for the State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.

sentences.text:
After going through the statement of prosecutrix, it is evident that she herself had gone with the applicant on 22.1.2024 and remained with him upto 5.2.2024 and it is alleged that during this period physical relationship was made and she also got married to the present applicant, as per scholar register the age of prosecutrix was 17 years and 5 months on the date of incident,
considering the aforesaid, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

Therefore,
without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

5. It is directed that Applicant- Mayank shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the court below.
C.c. as per rules.
